ragnarokGoCodes.title: Ragnarok: GO Codes and Free Rewards
ragnarokGoCodes.intro: Ragnarok: GO distributes gift codes and limited-time rewards through its official website, Facebook page, and Discord announcements. Redeem codes as soon as they appear, because event rewards and redemption windows are tied to specific campaigns.

sources.label: Official Website Announcements
sources.reward: Event-linked items, progression resources, and promotional rewards
sources.howToRedeem: Open the official Ragnarok: GO website, find the campaign announcement, copy the published code, and redeem it through the in-game or account redemption entry shown by the event.

sources.label: Official Facebook Campaigns
sources.reward: Social-media event rewards and limited-time promotional items
sources.howToRedeem: Open the official Ragnarok: GO Facebook page, copy the code from the campaign post, then enter it through the redemption interface specified in the announcement.

sources.label: Official Discord Announcements
sources.reward: Community-event rewards, maintenance compensation, and server celebration items
sources.howToRedeem: Join the official Ragnarok: GO Discord server, review the announcement channel, copy the current code, and complete redemption before the listed deadline.

quickTips: Codes are published through official channels only, so redeem them through the entry named in each announcement.
Event codes usually expire with their campaign, so redeem as soon as they are posted.
New players receive 4,000 free draws at launch, and codes stack on top of those starting rewards.
Bookmark this page and check back after every maintenance, event, and server celebration for the latest codes.

ragnarokGoBeginnerGuide.title: Ragnarok: GO Beginner Guide
ragnarokGoBeginnerGuide.intro: The early game in Ragnarok: GO is built around completing the main story, unlocking core systems, collecting beginner rewards, and establishing a repeatable daily routine. Prioritize account progression first, then grow combat power through equipment, pets, and idle rewards.

steps.title: Create Your Account and Claim Starting Rewards
steps.description: Register through the official mobile client, then collect every beginner gift, mailbox reward, sign-in reward, and event reward before spending anything. Finish the tutorial so the main story, combat controls, and progression screens are all available.
steps.mistake: Spending premium currency immediately instead of checking beginner missions, event pages, and the mailbox first.

steps.title: Push the Main Story to Unlock Core Systems
steps.description: Advance through the main story whenever the recommended combat power allows it. Story progression unlocks additional combat, equipment, pet, quest, and resource systems, so it stays the fastest path to a complete account.
steps.mistake: Focusing on optional farming content while important progression systems remain locked behind the main story.

steps.title: Establish the Daily and Offline Growth Routine
steps.description: Collect idle and offline rewards regularly so accumulated resources never sit at the storage limit. Complete daily missions and limited-time activities, then spend stamina on the resource stage that addresses your current bottleneck.
steps.mistake: Ignoring offline rewards until storage fills up, or spreading scarce upgrade materials across too many low-priority options.

quickTips: Auto-battle keeps farming while you are away, and offline progression keeps accumulating for 24/7 growth.
Spend your 4,000 new-player draws only after checking which banner fits your account plan.
Upgrade your main weapon first; it improves every stage, boss fight, and farming route at once.
Join a team dungeon as soon as it unlocks, since group rewards accelerate early growth.

ragnarokGoTierList.title: Ragnarok: GO Tier List by Combat Role
ragnarokGoTierList.intro: This role-based ranking for Ragnarok: GO focuses on practical account value instead of a single score for every build. A role performs differently depending on equipment quality, pet investment, enemy composition, and whether the goal is story progression, boss damage, team utility, or arena performance.

tiers.examples: Ranged damage and consistent single-target damage builds
tiers.evaluation: High sustained damage is valuable across most content because it improves clear speed while staying effective against durable targets.
tiers.investmentNote: Prioritize reliable damage scaling, survivability, and equipment upgrades that maintain output during extended fights.

tiers.evaluation: A durable frontline stabilizes difficult encounters and protects damage-focused teammates, though it clears solo content more slowly.
tiers.investmentNote: Balance defensive stats with enough damage to avoid excessively long encounters.

tiers.evaluation: Support builds gain value when content requires sustained healing, defensive utility, or offensive enhancement for the whole team.
tiers.investmentNote: Support performance depends on team composition, timing, and the availability of content that rewards group utility.

tiers.evaluation: Burst and control excel when enemies can be disabled or defeated quickly, but results are more sensitive to resistance, timing, and encounter design.
tiers.investmentNote: Keep a dependable general-purpose setup before committing most resources to a specialized burst build.

ragnarokGoRerollGuide.title: Ragnarok: GO Reroll Guide
ragnarokGoRerollGuide.intro: Rerolling in Ragnarok: GO is most useful when the early summon pool offers a meaningful advantage and the reset process is quick. Complete the tutorial and beginner reward claims first, record your available free summons, then decide whether the account has enough long-term value to keep.

steps.title: Complete the Fastest Available Opening Route
steps.description: Finish the tutorial and the first required story objectives. Claim beginner missions, mailbox rewards, sign-in rewards, and event rewards before summoning, then use all free summon tickets and early currency intended for the initial account setup.
steps.decision: Do not reroll before collecting the full set of available beginner resources.
steps.keepCondition: The account receives a useful early combat option and still holds enough resources for the next guaranteed or target summon.

steps.title: Prioritize a Complete Early Team Over One Isolated Result
steps.description: Favor results that improve main damage, survivability, and progression consistency. A complementary mix of damage, defense, recovery, and utility beats a single option that cannot function without heavy investment.
steps.decision: Reroll when the opening result provides no practical improvement to story progression or early combat stability.
steps.keepCondition: The account has at least one dependable progression core and a clear path for spending future free summons.

steps.title: Spend Free Summons in a Controlled Order
steps.description: Use free tickets and beginner currency before premium currency, so savings stay available for targeted banners and guaranteed rewards. Complete beginner objectives that grant extra summons before making the final keep-or-reset decision.
steps.decision: Keep the account when the early roster is stable, progression is smooth, and remaining resources support the next upgrade milestone.
steps.keepCondition: The account has a usable main team, meaningful early rewards have been claimed, and restarting would cost more time than the expected improvement.

ragnarokGoClassesAndJobs.title: Ragnarok: GO Classes and Jobs
ragnarokGoClassesAndJobs.intro: Ragnarok: GO classes are built around classic Ragnarok job archetypes. Use this comparison to choose between direct damage, ranged farming, spell casting, frontline durability, party support, and economy-focused progression.

classes.name: Swordsman

strengths: Strong frontline presence in team content

classes.name: Archer
classes.coreFocus: Ranged attack, attack speed, critical hits, and single-target damage
strengths: Strong against mobile or dangerous enemies
classes.partyValue: High as a consistent ranged damage dealer

classes.name: Mage
classes.coreFocus: Magic attack, elemental damage, skill damage, and area-of-effect abilities

classes.name: Acolyte
classes.coreFocus: Healing, buffs, recovery, defensive support, or close-range martial damage
strengths: Specializes in support or hybrid damage

classes.name: Thief
classes.coreFocus: Attack speed, critical hits, evasion, burst damage, and flexible positioning
classes.partyValue: High as a burst damage specialist

classes.name: Merchant
classes.role: Economic utility, physical damage, or consumable support
classes.coreFocus: Equipment improvement, physical attack, crafting utility, and resource efficiency

ragnarokGoProgressionGuide.title: Ragnarok: GO Progression Guide
ragnarokGoProgressionGuide.intro: Efficient progression in Ragnarok: GO comes from completing high-value daily activities before spending stamina or enhancement materials. Prioritize permanent account growth, keep offline rewards active, and upgrade the equipment that directly improves your current farming target.

steps.title: Unlock the Core Progression Systems
objectives: Follow the main story until the primary combat and reward systems are available
Complete tutorial objectives and beginner missions
Claim available login, growth, and first-clear rewards
Equip the strongest immediately usable gear instead of saving low-level items
steps.priority: Complete before spending large amounts of enhancement materials
steps.dailyRoutine: Collect offline earnings, finish available daily tasks, and push the main story until the next progression gate.

steps.title: Establish a Reliable Farming Setup
objectives: Select a farming location that can be cleared consistently
Keep idle and offline rewards running whenever you are not actively playing
Use stamina and daily attempts on the highest available reward tier
Upgrade the primary weapon and the most important damage or survival equipment first
steps.priority: Improve clear speed and survival before spreading resources across every slot
steps.dailyRoutine: Collect offline rewards, complete daily missions, run resource stages, and return to the highest stable farming area.

steps.title: Prioritize Permanent Account Growth
objectives: Complete recurring activities that provide account-wide or long-term progression
Advance equipment enhancement only when the current content requires it
Save scarce materials for equipment with long-term value
Use team content to obtain resources that are inefficient to farm alone
steps.priority: Favor permanent upgrades over temporary power increases
steps.dailyRoutine: Finish daily missions, limited attempts, team content, resource stages, and offline reward collection before manual farming.

steps.title: Push Content with Targeted Upgrades
objectives: Identify the exact stat or damage requirement blocking the next stage
Upgrade the weapon or equipment slot that addresses that bottleneck
Improve pets, partners, and supporting systems after the main combat setup is stable
Spend event currencies on materials that are difficult to obtain through normal play
steps.priority: Solve the current progression bottleneck instead of upgrading randomly
steps.dailyRoutine: Complete all limited attempts first, then use remaining time and stamina on the best available farming stage.

steps.title: Optimize Weekly and Long-Term Goals
objectives: Maintain a consistent daily activity cycle
Target higher difficulty stages for better equipment and enhancement materials
Prepare separate setups for story pushing, bosses, team dungeons, and farming
Plan around limited-time rewards, event exchanges, and reset schedules
steps.priority: Convert daily activity into steady long-term account growth
steps.dailyRoutine: Claim all rewards, complete reset-based content, use limited attempts, maintain offline farming, and review the next upgrade target.

ragnarokGoEquipmentAndPets.title: Ragnarok: GO Equipment and Pets
ragnarokGoEquipmentAndPets.intro: Avoid distributing materials evenly across every item in Ragnarok: GO. Start with the equipment slot that provides the largest direct improvement to your class, then build a balanced setup for survival and sustained damage. Pets and partners should support the same combat objective rather than introduce conflicting stats.

setups.title: Story and Stage Progression
setup: Use the strongest available class-appropriate weapon
Prioritize equipment that improves main damage and basic survivability
Choose a pet or partner that supports consistent clearing rather than short burst windows
upgradePriority: Defensive equipment for the current stage
setups.materialFocus: Spend common enhancement materials on the main weapon and core equipment that stay useful across several stages.

setups.title: Boss Encounters
setup: Use single-target damage equipment and class-appropriate offensive stats
Keep enough defensive power to survive mechanics and extended combat
Select a pet or partner that improves sustained damage, critical output, or survivability
setups.materialFocus: Prioritize upgrades that increase damage over the full duration of the encounter instead of short opening bursts.

setups.title: Team Dungeons
setup: Build around the party role you are expected to perform
Damage dealers maximize reliable output while keeping enough defense
Support characters prioritize healing, buffs, and team survivability
Frontline characters favor durability and threat retention
setups.materialFocus: Coordinate upgrades with the role your team needs most instead of copying a damage-only setup.

setups.title: Idle and Offline Farming
setup: Use equipment that allows consistent clearing without manual intervention
Favor attack speed, area damage, resource efficiency, or sustain depending on the class
Choose pets or partners that improve clear stability and reduce downtime
Select a farming area that can be cleared repeatedly without frequent defeats
setups.materialFocus: Invest in upgrades that improve rewards per hour and keep the character farming continuously.

ragnarokGoEventsAndRewards.title: Ragnarok: GO Events and Rewards
ragnarokGoEventsAndRewards.intro: Event rewards in Ragnarok: GO are easiest to miss when they are spread across login pages, mission panels, event shops, and limited dungeons. Check the event panel and announcement channels each day, complete time-limited objectives first, and spend event currency before the exchange period ends.

events.title: Daily Login and Sign-In Rewards
events.time: Recurring daily activity, claimed through the active login calendar
conditions: Log in during the active calendar period
Open the event or sign-in interface
Claim each available day before the calendar expires
events.reminder: Claim manually when required and check whether missed days can be recovered.

events.title: Launch and Growth Campaigns
events.time: Available during the active launch or growth campaign period
conditions: Create or progress a character during the campaign window
Reach the listed level, story, or account milestones
Claim milestone rewards from the campaign interface
events.reminder: Review milestone requirements early so progress is not delayed by an avoidable level or story prerequisite.

events.title: Limited-Time Dungeons and Challenges
events.time: Available only during the schedule shown in the active event notice
conditions: Meet the displayed level or unlock requirement
Use the available daily or event attempts
Complete the dungeon or challenge before the event closes
events.reminder: Use limited attempts before completing ordinary farming activities.

events.title: Free Draws and Recruitment Rewards
events.time: Available during the active draw or recruitment campaign
conditions: Open the relevant draw or recruitment page
Use free attempts within the displayed reset period
Complete associated event missions when available
events.reminder: Free attempts may reset daily or expire with the campaign, so check the remaining time before leaving the event page.

events.title: Event Exchange Shops
events.time: Open while the related event currency and exchange period remain active
conditions: Earn event currency from the associated missions or activities
Spend currency before the exchange deadline
rewards: Limited cosmetics and event items when listed
events.reminder: Compare item limits and purchase the hardest-to-obtain progression resources first.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Ragnarok: GO

questions.question: What is Ragnarok: GO?
questions.answer: Ragnarok: GO is a Gravity-authorized pixel-art idle RPG for mobile. It combines auto-battle, offline progression, pets, job class changes, team dungeons, boss challenges, and real-time chat in a classic Ragnarok world.

questions.question: Is Ragnarok: GO free to play?
questions.answer: Yes. Ragnarok: GO is free to download and play on iOS and Android, and new players receive 4,000 free draws at launch. Optional in-app purchases are available.

questions.question: Which platforms and regions is Ragnarok: GO available in?
questions.answer: Ragnarok: GO launched on iOS and Android across 11 Southeast Asian regions, with the App Store listing support for English plus 10 more languages.

questions.question: Does Ragnarok: GO support offline progression?
questions.answer: Yes. Auto-battle and offline growth run around the clock, so your character keeps farming and collecting rewards even while you are away.

questions.question: Can I change job classes in Ragnarok: GO?
questions.answer: Yes. Ragnarok: GO uses classic Ragnarok advancement routes such as Swordsman to Knight or Crusader, Archer to Hunter, and Mage to Wizard, letting you specialize your build as you progress.

questions.question: Where can I find the latest Ragnarok: GO codes?
questions.answer: Check the Ragnarok: GO codes section on this site for gift codes from the official website, Facebook campaigns, and Discord announcements, along with redemption steps and expiry details.
